title: androsace villosissima
intro: Androsace villosissima, commonly known as Himalayan rock jasmine, is a flowering plant species native to the Himalayan region. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly in traditional Tibetan medicine, where it is used to treat various ailments. The health benefits of Androsace villosissima include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which have been shown to have therapeutic actions such as reducing fever and alleviating respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
